The '''Rocrin system''' was a [[Binary star system/Legends|binary star]] [[Star system/Legends|system]]<ref name="XWvTF:BoP" /> that was located in the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]], on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" />

[[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force Vengeance]] had set up an [[Battle of Rocrin|ambush]] to destroy a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] convoy using the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Rage (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Rage'']], accompanied by the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]] ''[[Compellor/Legends|Compellor]]''. [[Avenger Squadron/Legends|Avenger Squadron]] identified the contents of the convoy, then with the help of [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]], destroyed the convoy down to the last ship.
